identity.roleNote: The production and default catalog remains AM5 + DDR5 scoped (O2). A non-AM5 DDR5 motherboard may exist only when it is explicitly designated as a negative fixture whose purpose is to exercise cpu-socket: incompatible. This board is that designated negative fixture (C15).

dimensionsMm.assignmentBasis: ASUS prints a two-figure board outline in centimetres, recorded here in millimetres as the board's two in-plane dimensions. thicknessMm is absent because the page publishes no board thickness; it is not filled from the Micro-ATX form factor, which standardises mounting geometry rather than this SKU's physical dimensions.

notes: Published facts from source.cat6.asus.tuf-gaming-b860m-plus-wifi.techspec, kept verbatim. CPU socket 'LGA1851', supporting Intel Core Ultra Processors (Series 2). Chipset 'Intel B860'. Memory 'DDR5', 4 DIMMs, maximum capacity 256GB. Form factor 'mATX', which maps to compat2's Micro-ATX. maxMemorySpeedMtS is absent: ASUS publishes the ceiling as 'Support up to 8800+MT/s (OC)', where the trailing '+' states a floor for the overclocking ceiling rather than an exact maximum, so recording a number would invent one. checkRamSupport reports unavailable for this board as a result, which is the true statement; the socket and form factor are unaffected and still drive their own checks. BIOS: biosMinVersionForCpu is deliberately empty under O6.
